# Pearlecent Shifah Medical Center L.L.C.

> Family dental clinic in Al Rigga, Deira, Dubai (also known as Pearlescent Dental; established in 2018 as Dr. Safar Clinic). General Dentists and an Orthodontic Specialist. Free first general dental consultation.

- Address: Room 104, First Floor, Al Zarooni Building, 73 Al Rigga Road, Al Muraqqabat, Deira, Dubai, UAE
- Phone: +971 55 339 6152 (mobile and WhatsApp), 04 266 4100 (landline)

## Treatments
- General Dentistry: Free Dental Examinations and Check-ups, Tooth Cleaning (Scaling and Polishing), Tooth Extraction (Surgical / Non-Surgical)
- Restorative Dentistry: Tooth Colored Fillings (Composite / GIC), Root Canal Treatment, Dental Crowns, Dental Bridges, Inlays / Onlays
- Cosmetic Dentistry: Teeth Whitening, Dental Veneers – Composite, E-max and Zirconia, Full Mouth Veneers / Hollywood Smile, Tooth Jewellery, Smile Makeover, Snap On Veneers
- Orthodontics – Braces & Teeth Alignment: Metal Braces, Ceramic and Crystal Braces, Lingual Braces, Damon Braces / Self Ligating, Clear Aligners / Invisalign
- Dentures & Retainers: Removable Partial Dentures (Acrylic / Flexible), Complete Denture, Clear Retainers, Lingual Retainers, Hawley’s Retainers
- Other Dental Services: TMJ Consultation, Mouth Guard, Preventive Dental Care, Pedodontic Treatments, Fluoride Treatment, Dental X-ray, Digital Dentistry
